newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares extend fall in lower turnover.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares extend fall in lower turnover.

text.p: 1130 GMT - Polish shares fell for the third session running in lower trade, which was roughly balanced after price-fixing. * The main market's WIG index fell 352.5 points, or 2.1 percent, to 16,316.6, the WIG 20 fell 2.4 percent to 1,611.9 and the parallel market's WIRR fell 2.4 percent to 3,562.9. * Turnover fell 10.2 percent to 161 million zlotys on all three markets as 76 issues fell, eight rose and 11 were flat. Sell offers for 13 stocks and buy orders for 11 were not matched. Most active Universal fell four percent in 9.9-million-zloty trade. NFI units fell 3.5 percent in 12.1-million-zloty trade. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
